Study Links Long Covid Severity to Changes in Mouth and Lung Bacteria

A recent study has found a potential link between the severity of Long Covid symptoms and alterations in the bacteria present in the mouth and lungs. The research suggests that changes in these microbial communities may play a role in the persistent effects experienced by some individuals after a COVID-19 infection.
